description: This file defines an interface called ResettableMetricInstrument, which extends MetricInstrument and adds a method to reset the metric, indicating its purpose related to metrics measurement and reset capability.

classes.name: ResettableMetricInstrument
classes.description: An interface representing a metric instrument that can be reset.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the metric. Returns true if the reset was successful, false otherwise.
